name: Dumbbell Sumo Squat
steps: Stand tall with your feet set wide and toes turned out roughly 45 degrees, holding one dumbbell vertically with both hands between your thighs.
Brace your core, lift your chest, and let your arms hang straight down beneath your shoulders.
Bend your knees and hips smoothly to lower straight down until your thighs reach parallel while keeping the dumbbell centered.
Drive through your whole foot to stand tall and squeeze your glutes cleanly at the top.
tips: Push your knees outward in line with your angled toes so they do not cave inward.
Keep your torso tall rather than folding far forward as you descend.
